# netbox_available_asn (Resource)

Allocates the next free AS number from an ASN range. Import with "<asn_range_id> <asn_id>".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_rir" "example" {
  name = "Example RIR"
  slug = "example-rir"
}

resource "netbox_asn_range" "example" {
  name   = "Example range"
  slug   = "example-range"
  rir_id = netbox_rir.example.id
  start  = 64512
  end    = 65534
}

// NetBox picks the next free AS number of the range
resource "netbox_available_asn" "example" {
  asn_range_id = netbox_asn_range.example.id
  description  = "Allocated by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asn_range_id` (Number) The ID of the ASN range the AS number is taken from.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments field for the AS Number record.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) Description field for the AS Number record.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the available asn. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the available asn. Needs NetBox 4.6.0 or later.
- `sites` (Set of Number) The IDs of the sites the AS number is assigned to. The sites can also list their AS numbers with `available asn_ids`, so set the relation on one side only. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the available asn.

### Read-Only

- `asn` (Number) The AS number that NetBox picked.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rir_id` (Number) The ID of the RIR of the ASN range.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is "<asn_range_id> <asn_id>", the numeric NetBox IDs of the ASN range and of the AS number
terraform import netbox_available_asn.example "1 5"
```
